newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian killed in Libyan police, militants clash.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian killed in Libyan police, militants clash.

text.p: Libyan security forces accidentally shot to death an Egyptian man in the Libyan coastal town of Benghazi during a shootout with suspected Islamist militants, security sources said on Monday.

They said Khaled Ibrahim, 30, was sitting at a cafeteria when he was caught in the crossfire. Travellers say that Benghazi has been the site of many clashes between Libyan security and opponents to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.
The Libyans transported Ibrahim's body to Egypt on Sunday, the sources added.
